name.en: Alalcomenaeus cambricus — Burgess Shale whole-animal study

scope: Original static complete animal informed by actual whole Burgess Shale specimens ROM45616/53352; not same-specimen replica, scientific scan or substitute of indeterminate Chinese/Utah Alalcomenaeus. Existing inventory slot.

scale.basis: Artist nominal adult values, not one specimen metric. ROM lists photographed specimens45mm/55mm; frontal filament extent and width/depth are artistic parameters, with all bounds recorded after posing.

pose: Static near-bottom swimming/resting interpretation, body gently arched, head -Y, spatulate tail +Y; limbs spread modestly without splaying as a centipede. Lowest exported surface at Z0 is datum, not foot-ground or habitat claim. No base or water.

coordinates.origin: Horizontal animal bounds center; lowest exported surface Z0 as display datum, not ground-contact claim.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–5 muted slate-blue/olive/ochre tones plus dark eyes; original art, no fossil pigment claim.
surface_profile.detail: Coherent softly faceted closed solids, controlled taper; solid slightly thickened lamellar fringe simplification; no alpha cards or ornamental shell spots.

morphology.obligation: Eleven trunk tergites, enclosing pleural flanks and paired dorsal carinae; broad shield tapering forward, no inflated bivalved shell.

Paired compact-base great appendages, each with three flagellate claws; two posterior cephalic biramous pairs and eleven trunk pairs. Outer branches paddle-like/fringed; inner branches jointed and restrainedly spinose.
Single broad spatulate telson with posterior planar fringe; not a pointed Leanchoilia tail, three tail paddles, or shrimp fan.
Two prominent short-stalked lateral eyes. Three tiny median ocelli follow the selected Burgess1999/2023 interpretation, explicitly uncertain; do not build five equally large eye stalks.

scientific_limits: Whole fossils preserve the body; original 3D depth, posture, colors, tiny setal density and some proximal limb attachments remain interpretive. Do not model rock cracks or mineral shine as anatomy.

Eye interpretation differs:1999 and2023 accounts favor three median eyes in A.cambricus; current ROM page says a smaller median pair for leanchoiliids. Adopt the documented1999 alternative for this asset, with three understated ocelli and an explicit uncertainty label; do not call this resolved consensus.
No nervous-system reconstruction or phylogeny claim; historical and recent literature disputes internal traces. Whole external shape does not require settling that debate.
No transfer of Chengjiang/Utah indeterminate species proportions or extra limbs; no anatomical exactness or all-era coexistence claim.

view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB; save camera/light config and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default. Only a specific unresolved factual or technical issue justifies one focused diagnostic.

acceptance_obligations: Preserve eleven tergites, compact-based triflagellate frontal appendages and broad single spatulate tail. Shape must differ from existing Leanchoilia, not just palette/size/pose.

Four fixed final views suffice. Front checks paired eye/appendage organization, side coherent carapace/limb layers, top eleven-segment enclosing flank and spatulate tail, perspective full readable depth.

EXPORT contains exactly one asset-named identity root, intended meshes descendants only. Cameras/lights outside. Applied positive transforms, outward winding, single-sided OPAQUE materials; no DoubleSide workaround.
Default shared helper thresholds unchanged. Use current asset_common and exactGLB renderer; record dependency hashes/runtime/exporter versions.

Two COMPLETE isolated factory-startup rebuilds from same generator/config/seed, compare exact GLB SHA256 AND decoded geometry/material semantic digest, bounds/counts. Two exports of one scene do not qualify.
Editable .blend reopen/reexport verification plus native/export metrics, Khronos validation and scoped runtime parse. Preserve all logs.
Independent QA separate from maker. GPU-world/user acceptance/merge/deploy not run and not prerequisites to begin static making; never claim them passed.
production_plan: Coordinator claims existing alalcomenaeus slot after current duplicate recheck. Maker inspects the two actual2560px source images locally before geometry.
Create new parameterized deterministic generator; use eleven named segments and mapped cephalic/trunk appendages, not recolored Leanchoilia mesh.
Four cheap graybox views establish enclosing flank, compact claw bases and broad spatula tail first; no mandatory extra views.
Apply controlled palette, single-root export and complete two-build byte/semantic check. Keep eye choice and interpretation in metadata.
Hand exact GLB/Blend/source/ref manifest and four views to separate reviewer; no upload or public release from this preparation.
required_deliverables: real-reference ledger with private source pixels
two full build logs and byte/semantic comparison
